FS is a writable expand-down segment (type 6), D/B=1, limit=FFFFh.
Offsets 10000h..FFFFFFFFh are valid; offsets 0..FFFFh are invalid.
The old ordinary-memory check incorrectly used expand-up bounds.
It permitted the preceding FS:[EAX] read at EAX=0 to read the IVT, then
rejected INC dword FS:[EAX+28h] with EAX=00c90f9e.

SDM rev.090 Vol.3A 6.3, pp.6-4--6-5, and 3.4.5, p.3-10, define
the lower exclusive limit and upper bound selected by D/B.
